name: tract_developer_kickout_caps_styles
description: Kick-out, the developer caps and the style checks, by hand from 4.2, 4.4, 4.7, 4.8 and 4.17. Part 1: residential wealth-2 developer 1 (subtype 0x1020), demand 1 (desired 1, desiredMax 1); a wealth-1 developer 2 with power cap 0; lot 1 occupied (state 3) by wealth 1, building 0x200 (purpose 1, wealth 1, capacity 6), configuration stage 1. Kick-out (shipped true) makes it eligible; IsLotSuitable(L, false) passes (6c skipped by kick-out, 6g: different wealth needs maxStage 1 >= 1). Power and water use the caps of the building's developer (BDS GetDeveloper(1, 1) = developer 2): stage 1 > 0 and the cell's power value 0 < 2 -> 26 (row 1 only counts 27 and 1). A 2 x 2 wealth-2 configuration makes ListPossibleLotConfigurations give 27 while listing nothing (existing: size 5; aggregation: no lot around, 5; subdivision: w < cw, 3), so each pass pushes best = max(26, 5, 5, 3) = 26: outcomes [26, 26], row 0 {26: 2}. Part 2: developer 2's power cap 255, developer 1's fire cap 0 and no fire coverage at the cell: fire uses this developer's caps -> 23: outcomes [23, 23]. Part 3: fire cap 255: the lot is taken over: AbandonBuilding(1, 5) (state 3: kick out) then ReoccupyBuilding(1, 0x1020); T1 = trunc(r24(1 x 1.2f)) = 1, 6 > 1 stops: Grow returns 6, outcomes [27]. Part 4: residential wealth-1 developer 3, active styles {0x2000, 0x2001} at index 0, one empty lot and one configuration compatible only with style 0x2001. singleStyle: check 4 of 4.7 tests the current style 0x2000 -> 9 in both passes (row 7 {9: 2}), nothing pushed. With all styles at once the configuration passes (compatible with 0x2001); PickBuilding (no style map, group 0) chooses it (R4), but IsBuildingCompatible check 3 tests only the current style 0x2000 [quirk] and the building is only in group 0x2001 -> 9, so PickBuilding returns 9 (no R5): outcomes [9, 9] (row 12 {9: 2}).
